categorisation: This gazette announces the filling of a vacancy in the Matara Pradeshiya Sabha (local government body) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes - declaring a candidate elected to fill a vacant member position in a local authority following established election procedures. This fits the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves candidate selection and declaration for local government positions under electoral laws.
